result.topic_en: Euler finds the divisors of the forms pp+3qq, pp−3qq (or 3pp−qq) and pp+5qq: the possible reduced forms of the divisors D, and the residue classes mod 4n in which the divisors must lie.

$D=4tt-2ts+ss=3tt+(t-s)^2$,
vnde patet fuperiorem conclufionem etiamnunc valere, femperque effe $D=rr+3ss$. Deinde pro formula $12i+a$, ob $a=pp$ erit $a=1$, tum vero formula $a=pp+3$ dat $a=7$[?], vnde omnes diuifores continebuntur in alterutra harum formularum: $12i+1$ vel $12i+7$, quas coniunctim ita repraefentemus: $12i+1,+7$, vel etiam hoc modo $12i+1,-5$. Si enim omnes valores ipfius $a$ infra $2n$ in genere deprimere liceat, admittendis fcilicet numeris negatiuis, tum altera formula $12i=a$, in qua nullus diuifor continetur, erit $12i+5$ et $12i+11$, vel $12i-1,+5$, vnde patet in genere valores ipfius $a$ negatiuos effe ipfius $a$.
Exemplum 6.
§. 23. Inuenire diuifores formulae $pp-3qq$ etiam $3pp-qq$.
Solutio.
Applicando hic problema quartum erit $n=3$, ideoque $g<\sqrt{3}$, confequentur $g=0$ et $fh=3$, vnde diuifor erit $D=rr-3ss$. Hinc patet, hos numeros nullos alios diuifores admittere, nifi qui fint eiusdem formae. Deinde pro formula $12i+a$, ob $a=pp$, vel $a=3-pp$, alii valores non prodeunt, praeter $a=1$, ita vt omnes diuifores continentur in hac forma: $12i\pm 1$. Formula igitur diuifores excludens erit $12i\pm 5$.

Scholion.
§. 24. Iftas formulas iam olim expediui, et demonftraui eas alios diuifores non admittere, nifi qui fint eiusdem formae, id quod in maioribus numeris pro $n$ affumtis non femper contingit. Conuenit autem eos cafus excludere, quibus $n$ eft vel numerus quadratus, vel per quadratum diuifibilis. Si enim foret $n=kmm$, tum formula $pp\pm kmmqq$ conueniret cum hac: $pp\pm kqq$.
Exemplum 7.
§. 25. Inuenire diuifores numerorum $pp+5qq$.
Solutio.
Ob $\sqrt{\tfrac{5}{3}}>g$ erit vel $g=0$ vel $g=1$; priori cafu fit $fh=5$, pofteriori vero $fh=6$. Prior cafus dat diuiforem $D=rr+5ss$, quae eft ipfa forma propofita; pofterior vero dat vel
$D=rr+2rs+6ss$ vel
$D=2rr+2rs+3ss$,
quarum formarum illa per reductionem ad primam redit, cum fit
$D=(r+s)^2+5ss$,
haec vero ab illa difcrepat, cum inde fiat
$2D=4rr+4rs+6ss=(2r+s)^2+5ss$;
vnde patet, omnes diuifores vel ipfos effe numeros huius formae, vel eorum dupla, ita vt, fi ipfe diuifor $D$ non fuerit formae $pp+5qq$, eius duplum $2D$ certe futurum fit huius formae. Deinde pro forma $20i+a$, ob $a=pp$ eius valores hinc nati erunt 1 et 9, ex altera autem for-

items.english: To find the divisors of the formula pp−3qq, and also of 3pp−qq.

items.quote: Iftas formulas iam olim expediui, et demonftraui eas alios diuifores non admittere, nifi qui fint eiusdem formae, id quod in maioribus numeris pro $n$ affumtis non femper contingit.
items.english: I dealt with these formulas long ago and showed that they admit no divisors other than those of the same form; this does not always happen when larger numbers are taken for n.
To find the divisors of numbers of the form pp+5qq.
